title: [Enforced Digital Vouchers] - Attaching EDocuments when using Digital Vouchers
summary: Digital Vouchers now automatically attach generated E-Documents to posted sales and purchase documents when configured to do so. The Digital Voucher Entry Setup table adds an E-Document check type option that streamlines compliance document management and reduces manual attachment effort.
key_points: New E-Document check type added to Digital Voucher Entry Setup for automating E-Document attachment
Automatic attachment of E-Document files to Incoming Document Files when posting sales or purchase documents
E-Document check type only available when Generate Automatically is enabled
E-Document option restricted to Sales Document or Purchase Document entry types
Enhanced automation reduces manual effort and ensures consistent document linking
quote: The system will automatically generate and attach E-Documents and related files to posted documents, streamlining document management and compliance.
